sections.title: The Capstone of the Master Instructor Track
learningObjectives: Understand how this module synthesizes the full L5 skill set
Recognize why observed delivery is the practical part of the final assessment, alongside a curriculum exam
sections.content: Every prior L5 module built toward one outcome: actually delivering training effectively. L5 certification combines a curriculum exam with an observed live delivery. The observed delivery is the heart of it, consistent with this curriculum's broader principle that practical competency requires practical demonstration, not just knowledge recall.

keyTerms.note: A live teaching session watched and assessed by an evaluator.

sections.title: What Observed Delivery Involves
learningObjectives: Understand the general format of an observed delivery assessment
Recognize what's being evaluated during the observation
sections.content: An observed delivery assessment means an experienced evaluator - senior faculty, working alongside DiFacto - watches the candidate actually teach a real or representative session. What's being evaluated isn't just technical accuracy, but the pedagogical skills built throughout L5: structuring the session, checking for understanding, giving effective feedback, and managing the training environment.

video.title: Observed delivery in 30 seconds
video.transcript: Observed delivery, in 30 seconds. An experienced evaluator watches you teach. Senior faculty, working alongside DiFacto. A real or representative session. Not just technical accuracy: teaching skills. Structure, checking understanding, feedback, environment. An unsuccessful attempt is feedback, not final.

sections.title: Preparing for Observed Delivery
learningObjectives: Understand how to prepare for this assessment format
Recognize the value of practice delivery before the formal assessment
sections.content: Preparation benefits from practice delivery - teaching the planned session to colleagues or in a low-stakes setting before the formal observed assessment, applying the feedback principles from L5-M1 to one's own developing instructional technique. Treating the first live delivery as the observed assessment itself, with no prior practice, raises unnecessary risk.

sections.title: The Evaluation Rubric
learningObjectives: Understand the general structure of the observed delivery evaluation
Recognize this as an application of the rubric design principles from L5-M2
sections.content: Observed delivery is evaluated against defined teaching competencies - a direct application of the rubric design principles covered in L5-M2, ensuring consistent evaluation regardless of which senior faculty member conducts the observation. Specific competency criteria will be confirmed as DiFacto's instructor certification process is finalized.

sections.title: Handling an Unsuccessful Observation
learningObjectives: Understand the general process if an observed delivery doesn't meet the certification bar
Recognize this as a developmental step, consistent with the re-sit policy used throughout the curriculum
sections.content: Consistent with the re-sit policy applied across other certification levels in this curriculum, an unsuccessful observed delivery isn't a final outcome - it's feedback, using the same principles from L5-M1, on specific areas to develop before a subsequent attempt. This mirrors the curriculum's broader philosophy that certification reflects genuine competency, worth the time to develop properly rather than rushing through.

keyTerms.note: Another attempt at an assessment after an unsuccessful one.

sections.title: Becoming Part of DiFacto's Instructor Network
learningObjectives: Understand what DiFacto Master IMR Instructor certification enables
Recognize the ongoing role within DiFacto's training ecosystem
sections.content: Successfully completing the curriculum exam and the observed delivery, alongside the preceding L5 modules, confers DiFacto Master IMR Instructor certification - jointly issued by DiFacto and senior faculty, keeping quality consistent across the instructor network. This certification enables training and certifying other MoRo users independently, making the certified instructor part of DiFacto's scaling mechanism for reaching customers and partners DiFacto's own team can't be present at every site to train directly.

questions.question: What does L5 certification combine?
options: Observed live delivery alone, with no written component
A written exam alone, taken after the final module
A curriculum exam plus an observed live delivery
questions.feedback: Correct. L5 certification combines a curriculum exam with an observed live delivery, consistent with practical competency requiring practical demonstration.

questions.question: During an observed delivery the candidate's content is technically accurate throughout. Is that enough to meet the bar?
options: No. Teaching skills such as session structure, checking for understanding, and feedback are also evaluated
Yes. Teaching skills were already checked in the module quizzes
Yes, as long as the session finishes within the planned time
questions.feedback: Correct. Observed delivery evaluates technical accuracy and teaching skills: structuring the session, checking understanding, giving feedback, and managing the training environment.

questions.question: What is the main risk of making the observed assessment your first live delivery of the session?
options: You have had no chance to get feedback and adjust your technique
The evaluator cannot score a session delivered for the first time
The session content cannot be changed after the assessment
questions.feedback: Correct. Practice delivery in a low-stakes setting lets you apply feedback to your own technique before the formal assessment.

questions.question: What happens if an observed delivery doesn't meet the certification bar?
options: The candidate must repeat every L5 module before another attempt
The candidate gets feedback on specific areas to develop, then makes another attempt
The result is final, and the candidate cannot attempt it again
questions.feedback: Correct. An unsuccessful observation is feedback for development, not a final outcome.

questions.question: What does DiFacto Master IMR Instructor certification enable?
options: Training and certifying other MoRo users independently
Training other MoRo users, with DiFacto staff carrying out each certification
Training and certifying, but only in sessions co-delivered with senior faculty
questions.feedback: Correct. Certified Master Instructors become part of DiFacto's scaling mechanism for training delivery.
